creative_angles.angle_brief: Position Scalevertise as the elite technical backbone of modern ad operations — not an agency, but an infrastructure layer. Appeals to founders who think in systems, not campaigns.
creative_angles.tone: Cold, precise, authoritative. Like a Bloomberg terminal ad.
creative_angles.hook_logic: Pattern interrupt — most agencies sell creativity. We sell architecture.

creative_angles.angle_brief: Attack the 'expensive agency' objection head-on. Show that $300/mo for full Meta infrastructure is asymmetric value vs. hiring in-house or using bloated retainer agencies.
creative_angles.tone: Direct, punchy, numbers-forward. Confidence without arrogance.
creative_angles.hook_logic: Price anchoring + contrast. Make $300 feel like stealing.

creative_angles.angle_brief: Speak directly to the pain: inconsistent leads, wasted ad spend, creatives that don't convert. Scalevertise is the fix. Empathy-first then pivot to capability.
creative_angles.tone: Empathetic, urgent, solution-oriented. Feels like the brand *gets it*.
creative_angles.hook_logic: Agitate the wound, then offer the cure. Classic direct-response.

creative_angles.angle_brief: Lean fully into the AI angle — predictive targeting, autonomous creative evolution, unified attribution. Position competitors as manual and outdated by contrast.
creative_angles.tone: Futuristic, technical, slightly elitist. For the forward-thinking operator.
creative_angles.hook_logic: Future-pacing. Makes the audience feel left behind if they don't act.

creative_angles.angle_brief: Let the work speak. Reference the client verticals (tattoo studios, dental, coaching) as proof that the system works across industries. Generalize the outcome: any brand, any vertical.
creative_angles.hook_logic: Borrowed credibility. If it worked for them, it works for you.
